LearnerProfile.title: LearnerProfile
LearnerProfile.description: User profile with avatar, progress, stars, streak, and badges for cross-device sync

avatar.description: Selected avatar emoji, key, or image data URL

completedUnits.description: Map of unit numbers to unit completion and stars status

activityLogs.description: Log history of recent account activities

AppBranding.title: AppBranding
AppBranding.description: Application custom branding including logo image and display sizes

customLogo.description: Base64 data URL or external URL for application logo

headerLogoSize.description: Logo size in pixels on the top navigation bar

welcomeLogoSize.description: Logo size in pixels on the welcome learner select screen

/learners/{learnerId}.description: Stores learner progress, stars, badges, and settings for real-time internet synchronization

/app_settings/{settingId}.description: Stores app-wide branding settings including logo image and display dimensions

/exercises/{grade}.description: Stores exercise clusters imported from JSON per grade for cross-device synchronization
